verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I can see the promised land
Though there's pain within the plan

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
There is vict'ry in the end
Your love is my battle cry

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
When my fears like Jericho
Build their walls around my soul

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
When my heart is overthrown
Your love is my battle cry
The anthem for all my life

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Every giant will fall
The mountains will move
Every chain of the past
You've broken in two

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Over fear over lies
We're singing the truth
That nothing is impossible
With You
Whoa

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
There is hope within the fight
In the wars that wage inside

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Though the shadows steal the light
Your love is my battle cry
The anthem for all my life

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
No greater name
no higher name
No stronger name
than Jesus

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
You overcame
broke every chain
Forever reign
King Jesus

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Nothing is impossible
Nothing is impossible
With You
Whoa
